announcements: 🎖️ Mission Accomplished! The Google Cloud Arcade 2026 standings are officially sealed & finalized.
🏆 344 Learners completed the mission! Congratulations to Champions m ganya, charan a m & dishanth d poojary.
🙏 Facilitators Sachin Upparna & Vikas A. L. commend all learners for their outstanding dedication!
⚠️ Mission Sunset Protocol: Portal will be officially decommissioned on or before the 2nd week of October 2026.
motivationalMessages: Mission Accomplished! You conquered the cloud, earned your badges, and made history.
Every Skill Badge secured is permanent engineering expertise in your portfolio.
Proud of the grit, late nights, and excellence displayed by all 344 cohort members.
The 2026 Arcade mission concludes, but your cloud engineering journey has just begun.
Mission Facilitators Sachin Upparna & Vikas A. L. salute your dedication and success!
